about: Synthetic cases for revival-check.py, both ways: each `flag` case must flag a revival of the named `kind`, each `spare` case must flag none. `piece` maps file names in the piece folder to their text; `rules` is a house rejected-rules.md. Invented text only; no writer's real cuts. Kept apart from tell-cases.json so a hook's cases arrive with its own change.
